title: ReportingFreqDTO
description: ReportingFreqDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

reportFrequencyCode.description: The code representing the frequency at which the report is generated.

monitoringPlanLocations.description: The locations covered under the monitoring plan.

beginQuarter.description: The quarter in which reporting starts.

endQuarter.description: The quarter in which reporting ends, if applicable.

id.description: The unique identifier for the reporting frequency record.

active.description: Indicates whether the reporting frequency record is active or not.
